structuralAndInstallationHolds.hold: DESIGN_DEVELOPMENT_NOT_FOR_CONSTRUCTION; engineeringApproved=false. Connection schedules, bearings, design actions, verified capacities and approved drawings are null for J01-J10; engineeringInputs including species/grade/sections/loads/wind/seismic/standards/bracing/erection/approval are null.

14 owner-confirmed arrangement members; visual section 0.24 × 0.45 m at Y +8.73 to +9.18 m; engineering section/bearing/splice/stability role null. They are not mounting supports or light/sound occluders in analysis.

Sanctuary model has no tie at axis 10 per printed sheet 5; roof thrust and member scheme still require engineer resolution. B01 package requirement retains intended restraint until analysis resolves it.

structuralAndInstallationHolds.topic: Lighting versus timber ornament / maintenance access
structuralAndInstallationHolds.hold: Upper curved rail/uprights not modelled because LA uplights occupy the same path; axis-9 tie haunches not modelled with L100/L103 close to columns; other tie haunches capped at 0.80 m with reading lights about 1.00 m from column axes; confirm fixture envelope and maintenance access.

structuralAndInstallationHolds.topic: Wall fan and pier bracket envelope
structuralAndInstallationHolds.hold: Wall fan mounts at axes 4, 6, 8 reach modeled elevation +5.90 m; pier brackets are limited to 0.42 m depth leaving about 0.34 m stated clearance; oscillation envelope and product dimensions require mechanical review.

Equipment attachment loads, drilling/cable holes, bearing/contact, roof build-up, weather/waterproofing, removable containment, cornice service cavities and maintenance access are not released. No load capacity is inferred from rendered brackets or beam meshes.

Supply/fault data, phases, conductor types/sizes, containment, protection, isolation, amplifier/channel design, terminal/control addresses, physical board-face layout and final scene matrix are pending. Routes are geometric centerlines and exclude allowances.
